Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 10 minutes Number of Servings: 3 Ingredients 2 cups cubed cantaloupe 1 cup low-fat lemon yogurt 1 cup orange juice Directions Blend all ingredients until smooth. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: This drink tastes best chilled. Try substituting honeydew or watermelon for cantaloupe. For a flavor booster, try lemon juice or frozen berries.
